statements.worth_reason: A named partner field trial (SoftBank, 16-layer MU-MIMO, ~3x spectral efficiency) is a real product-cycle datapoint for AI-RAN, but telecom RAN is immaterial to NVIDIA revenue and the trial carries no deployment, order or business scale, so it moves no revenue or margin answer.

"NVIDIA is collaborating with Nokia to deliver AI-RAN platforms" restates a long-running, already announced partnership in NVIDIA's own marketing blog, with no new scale, date, customer or deployment; an analyst covering NVIDIA already knows it, so it changes no answer.

grade_reason: A vendor technical blog with nothing that changes an answer; the output keeps one marginal trial result and one noise restatement of the Nokia partnership, correctly opens no question, and all fields are right.
standard_doubt: Section 5.1 class 2 with D240 ("后两条有名字、没金额，也留") plus D243 #6 ("文字或日期看不出是旧事的不算重提") lets "NVIDIA is collaborating with Nokia to deliver AI-RAN platforms integrated with Nokia anyRAN software" pass as an unsized named partnership; an analyst knows it is an old, already-priced partnership, so the standard keeps a restatement that is noise. The 'cannot tell from text' rule makes every vendor blog that re-mentions a known partner produce a record.
